'''ZUC''' is a stream [[cipher]] included in the [[Long Term Evolution]] standards used in 3GPP specifications for confidentiality and integrity.<ref name="3gpp">{{cite web | url = https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/Specs/archive/35_series/35.222/| title = 3GPP Technical Specification 35.222}}</ref><ref name="gsma">{{cite web | url = https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_ts/135200_135299/135222/14.00.00_60/ts_135222v140000p.pdf | title = Specification of the 3GPP Confidentiality and Integrity Algorithms 128-EEA3 & 128-EIA3: Document 2: ZUC Specification}}</ref> It is named after [[Zu Chongzhi]], the fifth-century Chinese mathematician.<ref name="Mpirical">{{cite web |url=https://www.mpirical.com/glossary/zuc-zu-chongzhi |title=ZUC |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2022 |website=Mpirical Glossary |publisher=Mpirical Ltd |access-date=1 Jun 2022}}</ref>

It uses a 16-stage [[linear feedback shift register]] with each stage in <math>{\rm GF}(2^{31}-1)</math> and produces a 32-bit word on each tick.
